set.body:
Type: epic
Work key: CX
Source: console walkthrough 2026-10-15 (demo data, 1440x900 and 390x844)

Outcome: A curator goes from a finding to an accepted fix without hunting through the tree or typing paths, reads a correction preview at a glance, and can tell what each release changed and why.

Visual design is consistent and stays; this epic targets flow and information density.

Out of scope here (already planned elsewhere):
- Dataset/lab/project discovery without UUID entry: F05.1 (bd-01M4W5P6KGS22KR04N7W3TVZZW).
- Grant listing, principal lookup and effective-access screens: F05.3 (bd-01M4W5P6Z7M1B4SV7A1DS3D0RX).
- Paged release inventories/history: W02.1 (bd-01M4W5PB5NYNV2A8EFBQKXPEBZ).
- Release-bound review outcomes: W02.4 (bd-01M4W5PBHHJ82VCE1RENFDEWQY).
- VoiceOver qualification: CON-03, deferred by product decision until the first screen-reader user.

Completion rule: every child closed with its probes in the console gate; one screenshot set at both widths attached as evidence.
set.title: CX: Make the core curation loop direct and the console legible
